meaningEn: stanning; the act of being an active fan of an idol or group.
exampleKo: 요즘 덕질 너무 행복해! 최애 보면서 힐링한다 진짜.
exampleEn: Stanning has been making me so happy lately! Just healing by watching my ultimate bias.

meaningEn: joining a fandom; the moment of becoming a fan of an idol or group.
exampleKo: 그 영상 보고 바로 입덕했잖아. 진짜 미모가 미쳤어.
exampleEn: I immediately joined the fandom after watching that video. Their visuals are insane.

meaningEn: leaving a fandom; quitting being a fan of an idol or group.
exampleKo: 현생 바빠서 탈덕할까 고민했는데, 컴백 티저 보고 포기했어.
exampleEn: I thought about leaving the fandom because I'm so busy with real life, but I gave up after seeing the comeback teaser.

meaningEn: a hiatus from stanning; taking a break from being an active fan.
exampleKo: 요즘 현생이 너무 힘들어서 잠시 휴덕하고 쉬어가려고 해.
exampleEn: Real life is so hard these days, so I'm thinking of taking a hiatus from stanning for a bit to rest.

meaningEn: ultimate bias (UB); one's absolute favorite member in a group.
exampleKo: 내 최애는 진짜 항상 빛나. 무대에서 너무 멋있어.
exampleEn: My ultimate bias always shines so brightly. They're so cool on stage.

meaningEn: bias wrecker; one's second-favorite member who often competes with their ultimate bias.
exampleKo: 요즘 내 차애가 너무 치고 올라와서 최애 흔들린다.
exampleEn: My bias wrecker has been coming for my ultimate bias so hard lately, I'm getting shaken.

meaningEn: favorite song; one's ultimate favorite song.
exampleKo: 이번 앨범 최애곡은 무조건 이거다. 완전 내 취향 저격이야.
exampleEn: This is definitely my favorite song from this album. It totally hits my taste.

meaningEn: main group/fandom; the primary idol group or fandom one dedicates most of their time and support to.
exampleKo: 내 본진은 다음 달에 컴백한대! 벌써부터 너무 기대돼.
exampleEn: My main group is making a comeback next month! I'm already so excited.

meaningEn: promoting/recruiting; the act of promoting one's idol to convince others to become fans.
exampleKo: 친구한테 우리 애들 영상 영업했는데 드디어 입덕했어!
exampleEn: I promoted videos of my faves to my friend and they finally joined the fandom!

meaningEn: fandom friend; a fellow fan with whom one shares their stanning activities.
exampleKo: 이번 콘서트 덕메랑 같이 가기로 했어! 너무 신난다.
exampleEn: I decided to go to this concert with my fandom friend! I'm so excited.

meaningEn: successful fan; a fan who has achieved a dream interaction with their idol, such as meeting them or getting noticed.
exampleKo: 팬사인회 가서 최애랑 눈 마주쳤어! 나 완전 성덕 됐어.
exampleEn: I went to the fan sign and made eye contact with my ultimate bias! I'm totally a successful fan now.

meaningEn: muggle; a non-fan, someone who is not involved in K-pop fandom.
exampleKo: 우리 그룹 노래가 머글들한테도 엄청 인기 많아졌어!
exampleEn: Our group's songs have become super popular even among muggles!

meaningEn: hardcore fan; an enthusiastic and often obsessive fan (derived from "otaku").
exampleKo: 나 진짜 우리 애들 덕후라서 굿즈 다 모으고 있어.
exampleEn: I'm such a hardcore fan of my faves, I'm collecting all their merchandise.

meaningEn: denial phase; the period of denying one's growing interest in an idol before fully acknowledging becoming a fan.
exampleKo: 지금 입덕부정기인데, 계속 영상 찾아보는 나를 발견한다.
exampleEn: I'm in my denial phase right now, but I keep finding myself looking up their videos.

meaningEn: "Stan happily anyway"; a fandom motto meaning "since you're going to stan anyway, you might as well do it happily."
exampleKo: 어덕행덕! 스트레스 받지 말고 우리 최애 보면서 행복하자.
exampleEn: Stan happily anyway! Don't get stressed, let's just be happy watching our ultimate bias.

meaningEn: over-immersion; being excessively emotionally invested or immersed in something, often to the point of forgetting reality.
exampleKo: 최애 리얼리티에 과몰입해서 마치 내가 같이 여행 간 것 같아.
exampleEn: I'm so over-immersed in my bias's reality show, it feels like I went on the trip with them.

meaningEn: multi-stan; a fan who follows and supports multiple idol groups or members across different fandoms.
exampleKo: 나는 잡덕이라서 매일 스케줄 보느라 정신없어.
exampleEn: I'm a multi-stan, so I'm always busy checking schedules every day.

meaningEn: OT-all fan; a fan who loves and supports all members of a group equally.
exampleKo: 우리 그룹은 올팬이 많아서 분위기가 너무 좋아.
exampleEn: Our group has a lot of OT-all fans, so the atmosphere is really good.

meaningEn: individual fan; a fan who primarily supports only one specific member of a group, often neglecting others.
exampleKo: 개인팬들 때문에 그룹 내 불화가 생기는 경우도 많아서 걱정돼.
exampleEn: I'm worried because individual fans often cause internal conflicts within the group.

meaningEn: fansite master; a fan who takes high-quality photos and videos of idols at events and shares them online.
exampleKo: 오늘 우리 최애 홈마 사진 떴는데 진짜 레전드야!
exampleEn: My bias's fansite master photos came out today and they're truly legendary!

meaningEn: "cannon lens"; a large telephoto camera lens used by fansite masters to take close-up photos of idols from a distance.
exampleKo: 홈마들 대포 들고 찍는 거 보면 진짜 대단하다고 느껴.
exampleEn: When I see fansite masters shooting with their "cannon lenses," I really think it's amazing.

meaningEn: goods/merch; official merchandise released by an idol group or company.
exampleKo: 이번 팝업 스토어 굿즈 너무 예뻐서 다 사고 싶다.
exampleEn: The merchandise at this pop-up store is so pretty, I want to buy everything.

meaningEn: photocard; a collectible photo card of an idol, often included in albums or sold as merchandise.
exampleKo: 앨범깡 했는데 최애 포카 나와서 소리 질렀잖아!
exampleEn: I unboxed the album and my ultimate bias's photocard came out, so I screamed!

meaningEn: light stick; an official fan light stick, unique to each group, waved at concerts and events.
exampleKo: 드디어 우리 그룹 응원봉 샀다! 콘서트에서 흔들 생각에 벌써 설레.
exampleEn: I finally bought our group's light stick! I'm already excited thinking about waving it at the concert.

meaningEn: slogan/banner; a fan-made or official banner/towel with a slogan, held up at concerts or events.
exampleKo: 최애 슬로건 들고 콘서트 가서 열심히 응원해야지.
exampleEn: I'm going to hold up my ultimate bias's slogan at the concert and cheer hard.

meaningEn: Lavish gifts or tributes that fans present to their idols, often expensive or custom-made.
exampleKo: 이번 생일 조공 진짜 역대급이었어! 팬들 사랑이 느껴진다.
exampleEn: This birthday jogong was seriously legendary! You can feel the fans' love.

meaningEn: Fan-funded support projects for an idol, such as food trucks for staff, billboard ads, or charity donations in their name.
exampleKo: 컴백 서포트 총대가 열렸어! 다 같이 참여해서 우리 아이돌 응원하자!
exampleEn: The comeback support project leader has opened up! Let's all participate and cheer on our idol!

meaningEn: A coordinated mass effort by fans, typically for streaming, voting, or buying albums, to help their idol achieve chart success or win awards.
exampleKo: 다들 스밍 총공 준비됐지? 우리 애들 1위 만들어주자!
exampleEn: Everyone ready for the streaming chonggong? Let's get our faves to #1!

meaningEn: Streaming a song repeatedly on music platforms to boost its chart rankings, often done by fans in coordinated efforts. (Short for 스트리밍)
exampleKo: 새 앨범 나왔으니까 다들 스밍 열심히 돌리자! 멜론 차트 뚫어야지!
exampleEn: The new album is out, so everyone stream hard! We need to break through the Melon charts!

meaningEn: A fan-run cafe event organized to celebrate an idol's birthday, often decorated with their photos and offering special merch.
exampleKo: 이번 주말에 친구랑 같이 우리 최애 생일카페 투어 가기로 했어! 너무 기대돼!
exampleEn: This weekend, my friend and I are going on a tour of our bias's birthday cafes! I'm so excited!

meaningEn: An LED billboard advertisement that fans purchase and display in public places, often to celebrate an idol's birthday, debut, or comeback.
exampleKo: 홍대입구역에 우리 아이돌 생일 전광판 걸렸대! 보러 가야겠다!
exampleEn: They say our idol's birthday billboard is up at Hongdae Entrance Station! I need to go see it!

meaningEn: The act of unboxing multiple copies of an album at once, primarily to collect the random photocards or other inclusions.
exampleKo: 이번 앨범 포카 다 모으려면 앨범깡 몇 개 더 해야 할까?
exampleEn: How many more album unboxings do I need to do to collect all the photocards for this album?

meaningEn: Support events or gifts that fans organize specifically for an idol's comeback period, such as food trucks for the set or promotional ads.
exampleKo: 다음 주 컴백서포트 모금 마감이니까 아직 참여 안 한 팬들은 서둘러줘!
exampleEn: The comeback support fundraising closes next week, so fans who haven't participated yet, please hurry!

meaningEn: A comeback; the period when an idol or group releases new music (album, single) and resumes active promotions, often after a hiatus.
exampleKo: 드디어 우리 오빠들 컴백 날짜 떴다! 달력에 표시해놔야지!
exampleEn: Our oppas' comeback date is finally out! I need to mark it on my calendar!

meaningEn: Debut; an idol or group's official first release of music or public appearance, marking the start of their career.
exampleKo: 벌써 데뷔 5주년이라니! 시간 진짜 빠르다. 앞으로도 꽃길만 걷자!
exampleEn: It's already their 5th debut anniversary! Time flies so fast. Let's only walk on flower paths from now on!

meaningEn: The final lineup of trainees who have been selected and confirmed to debut as a new idol group.
exampleKo: 이번 서바이벌에서 누가 데뷔조에 들지 너무 궁금하다. 내 픽이 꼭 데뷔했으면!
exampleEn: I'm so curious who will make it into the debut lineup from this survival show. I really hope my pick debuts!

meaningEn: A trainee; an aspiring idol undergoing a rigorous training program at an entertainment agency, hoping to debut.
exampleKo: 그 연습생 실력도 좋고 비주얼도 완벽해서 데뷔하면 대박일 것 같아.
exampleEn: That trainee has great skills and perfect visuals, I think they'll be a huge hit when they debut.

meaningEn: The promotion period for a new release (album or single), during which idols perform on music shows, attend events, and engage with fans.
exampleKo: 이번 활동 진짜 눈 깜짝할 새 끝났어. 벌써 다음 앨범 기다려진다.
exampleEn: This promotion period ended in the blink of an eye. I'm already looking forward to the next album.

meaningEn: The title track; the main promoted song of an album or single, often with a music video and extensive performances.
exampleKo: 이번 타이틀곡 안무 너무 멋있어! 무대 볼 때마다 소름 돋아.
exampleEn: The choreography for this title track is so cool! I get goosebumps every time I watch the stage.

meaningEn: An album track that is not the main title song; a b-side track.
exampleKo: 이번 앨범 수록곡들이 다 너무 좋아서 뭘 들어야 할지 모르겠어. 전곡 다 명곡!
exampleEn: All the b-sides on this album are so good, I don't know what to listen to. Every song is a masterpiece!

meaningEn: A digital track or single released to streaming sites and digital music platforms.
exampleKo: 이번 신곡 음원 차트에서 1위 찍었다! 다들 수고했어!
exampleEn: The new song hit #1 on the digital charts! Everyone worked hard!

meaningEn: A physical album or record, typically including a CD, photobook, and photocards.
exampleKo: 이번 음반 초동 기록 세웠대! 역시 우리 팬덤 화력 대단하다.
exampleEn: They set a new first-week sales record for this album! Our fandom's power is really amazing.

meaningEn: A mini album (EP); a release with more tracks than a single but fewer than a full-length album.
exampleKo: 다음 달에 미니앨범 나온대! 드디어 새 노래 들을 수 있겠다.
exampleEn: They're releasing a mini album next month! We can finally listen to new songs.

meaningEn: A full-length studio album (short for 정규 앨범), typically containing 10 or more tracks.
exampleKo: 드디어 첫 정규 앨범이 나온다니! 이건 무조건 소장해야 해.
exampleEn: They're finally releasing their first full-length album! I definitely have to own this.

meaningEn: A pre-release track dropped before the full album or single, often with a music video, to build anticipation.
exampleKo: 선공개 곡 듣고 이번 앨범 진짜 기대돼! 역시 믿듣돌이다.
exampleEn: After hearing the pre-release track, I'm so excited for this album! They're really a group you can trust to listen to.

meaningEn: A teaser image or video clip previewing an idol's upcoming comeback or release, designed to generate excitement.
exampleKo: 방금 올라온 티저 봤어? 이번 컨셉 대박 예감이야!
exampleEn: Did you see the teaser that just dropped? I have a feeling this concept is going to be amazing!

meaningEn: A music video (short for 뮤직비디오); a visual accompaniment to a song, often elaborate and cinematic.
exampleKo: 이번 뮤비 영상미 미쳤다! 감독님 진짜 천재 아니야?
exampleEn: The visuals in this music video are insane! Isn't the director a genius?

meaningEn: Choreography; the planned sequence of dance moves performed by idols, especially for their songs.
exampleKo: 이번 안무 진짜 어려워 보이던데, 연습생들이 얼마나 노력했을까?
exampleEn: This choreography looks really difficult, I wonder how hard the trainees practiced?

meaningEn: Razor-sharp, perfectly synchronized group dancing, a hallmark of many K-pop performances.
exampleKo: 쟤네 그룹은 칼군무가 진짜 예술이야. 한 치의 오차도 없어!
exampleEn: That group's kalgunmu is truly art. There's not a single mistake!

meaningEn: A fancam; a fan-recorded video focused on a single member's performance, often filmed during music shows or concerts.
exampleKo: 어제 무대 직캠 떴던데, 우리 최애 표정 연기 진짜 미쳤어!
exampleEn: The fancam from yesterday's stage dropped, and my bias's facial expressions are absolutely insane!

meaningEn: a music show broadcast; a music show
exampleKo: 오늘 음방에서 우리 애들 무대 너무 기대돼!
exampleEn: So excited for our faves' stage on the music show today!

meaningEn: a first-place win on a TV music show; a music show win
exampleKo: 와, 드디어 우리 오빠들 음방1위 했어! 너무 자랑스럽다!
exampleEn: Wow, our oppas finally got their first music show win! So proud!

meaningEn: an 'all-kill': topping every major music chart at once
exampleKo: 컴백하자마자 바로 올킬이라니, 역시 우리 그룹 대박이다!
exampleEn: An all-kill right after comeback, as expected, our group is amazing!

meaningEn: a song climbing the charts again long after release; a chart-reversal
exampleKo: 그 노래 발매된 지 한참 됐는데 요즘 역주행하고 있더라.
exampleEn: That song was released ages ago but it's having a chart-reversal lately.

meaningEn: charting; entering the music charts
exampleKo: 드디어 우리 신곡이 차트인했어! 너무 기뻐서 눈물 나!
exampleEn: Our new song finally charted! I'm so happy I could cry!

meaningEn: the first stage performance of a comeback
exampleKo: 내일 컴백무대 벌써부터 너무 설레서 잠이 안 와!
exampleEn: I'm so excited for tomorrow's comeback stage, I can't sleep!

meaningEn: an idol; a K-pop pop star
exampleKo: 요즘 새로 데뷔한 아이돌 중에 눈에 띄는 그룹 있어?
exampleEn: Is there any standout group among the idols who recently debuted?

meaningEn: the center; the focal member in formations and promotions
exampleKo: 이번 무대에서 ㅇㅇ이가 센터 포지션이라 너무 잘 보였어.
exampleEn: [Idol's name] was in the center position for this stage, so they stood out really well.

meaningEn: the main vocalist of a group
exampleKo: 우리 그룹 메인보컬 음색은 진짜 독보적이야.
exampleEn: Our group's main vocalist's vocal color is truly unique.

meaningEn: the lead vocalist (supports the main vocal)
exampleKo: 리드보컬이 고음 파트 진짜 안정적으로 잘 소화하더라.
exampleEn: The lead vocalist handled the high notes really stably.

meaningEn: the main dancer of a group
exampleKo: 메인댄서 직캠 보니까 역시 춤선이 너무 예뻐.
exampleEn: Watching the main dancer's fancam, their dance lines are so beautiful as expected.

meaningEn: the rapper of a group
exampleKo: 이 노래 래퍼 파트 진짜 중독성 있어서 계속 듣게 돼.
exampleEn: The rapper's part in this song is so addictive, I keep listening to it.

meaningEn: the youngest member (maknae)
exampleKo: 우리 막내 이제 성인인데 아직도 아기 같아 보여!
exampleEn: Our maknae is an adult now, but they still look like a baby!

meaningEn: the oldest member of a boy group (mathyeong)
exampleKo: 우리 맏형이 멤버들 다 잘 챙겨줘서 너무 듬직해.
exampleEn: Our oldest member takes good care of all the members, so reliable.

meaningEn: the leader of the group
exampleKo: 우리 리더는 그룹을 너무 잘 이끌어가서 항상 존경스러워.
exampleEn: Our leader leads the group so well, I always respect them.

meaningEn: the 'visual'; the member known as the best-looking
exampleKo: ㅇㅇ이는 진짜 비주얼 멤버라서 얼굴 천재야.
exampleEn: [Idol's name] is truly the visual member, a face genius.

meaningEn: the younger members of the group as a group (maknae line)
exampleKo: 우리 막내라인 조합은 진짜 귀여움 폭발이야!
exampleEn: Our maknae line combination is seriously cuteness overload!

meaningEn: the older members of a boy group as a group (hyung line)
exampleKo: 형라인 멤버들이 막내들을 잘 챙겨주는 모습이 너무 보기 좋아.
exampleEn: It's so nice to see the hyung line members taking good care of the maknaes.

meaningEn: a sub-unit; a smaller group within the group
exampleKo: 이번에 유닛 활동한다고 해서 너무 기대하고 있어!
exampleEn: I'm really looking forward to their sub-unit activities this time!

meaningEn: a boy group
exampleKo: 요즘 데뷔하는 보이그룹들은 다 실력이 장난 아니던데?
exampleEn: The boy groups debuting these days are all incredibly talented, aren't they?

meaningEn: a girl group
exampleKo: 요즘 제일 좋아하는 걸그룹은 누구야?
exampleEn: Who's your favorite girl group these days?

meaningEn: a solo artist or solo activity
exampleKo: ㅇㅇ이 솔로 앨범 발매 소식에 팬들 난리 났어!
exampleEn: Fans went wild at the news of [Idol's name]'s solo album release!

meaningEn: multinational; a group with members of multiple nationalities
exampleKo: 요즘은 다국적 그룹이 많아서 다양한 매력을 볼 수 있어서 좋아.
exampleEn: These days there are many multinational groups, so it's nice to see diverse charms.

meaningEn: an idol's real name (vs stage name)
exampleKo: ㅇㅇ이 본명 알면 깜짝 놀랄 걸? 완전 의외야!
exampleEn: You'd be surprised if you knew [Idol's name]'s real name! It's totally unexpected!

meaningEn: the concept/theme of a comeback (e.g., cute, dark, retro)
exampleKo: 이번 컴백 컨셉이 진짜 우리 그룹이랑 찰떡이야.
exampleEn: This comeback concept really suits our group perfectly.

meaningEn: a fansign event; a fansign
exampleKo: 이번 팬싸에서 멤버들이랑 얘기 많이 해서 너무 좋았어!
exampleEn: It was so good to talk a lot with the members at this fansign!

meaningEn: a video call fansign; a video call with an idol
exampleKo: 드디어 영통 당첨돼서 최애랑 영상통화 했다! 손 떨려 죽는 줄.
exampleEn: I finally won a video call fansign and got to video call my bias! My hands were shaking so much.

meaningEn: a fan meeting
exampleKo: 다음 주에 팬미팅 가는데 벌써부터 설렌다!
exampleEn: I'm going to the fan meeting next week, I'm already so excited!

meaningEn: a concert
exampleKo: 이번 콘 티켓팅 성공해서 너무 행복해!
exampleEn: I'm so happy I succeeded in ticketing for this concert!

meaningEn: a solo concert; a standalone concert by one group
exampleKo: 우리 애들 드디어 단콘 한다! 너무 기다렸어.
exampleEn: Our faves are finally having a solo concert! I've waited so long.

meaningEn: a world tour
exampleKo: 다음 월드투어는 꼭 갈 거야! 티켓팅 연습해야지.
exampleEn: I'm definitely going to the next world tour! Gotta practice ticketing.

meaningEn: new content, teasers, or updates released by an idol/group to excite fans
exampleKo: 오늘 떡밥 너무 많이 터져서 행복사할 지경이야.
exampleEn: So much new content dropped today, I'm practically dying of happiness.

meaningEn: behind-the-scenes footage or content
exampleKo: 앨범 자켓 비하인드 영상 보는데 멤버들 너무 귀엽더라.
exampleEn: The members were so cute watching the album jacket behind-the-scenes video.

meaningEn: self-produced content by the idol group, often variety shows or vlogs
exampleKo: 이번 자컨 진짜 레전드야! 꼭 봐야 해.
exampleEn: This self-produced content is a total legend! You absolutely have to watch it.

meaningEn: an idol's vlog
exampleKo: 멤버 브이로그 보는데 너무 힐링돼서 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어.
exampleEn: Watching the member's vlog was so healing, I didn't even notice time passing.

meaningEn: Weverse, a fan community platform where idols interact with fans and post content
exampleKo: 위버스 알림 오면 심장 떨어지는 줄 알았잖아!
exampleEn: When I get a Weverse notification, I always think my heart's going to drop!

meaningEn: idol-fan interaction or communication
exampleKo: 우리 애들은 팬들이랑 소통 진짜 잘해줘서 너무 고마워.
exampleEn: Our faves are so good at communicating with fans, I'm so grateful.

meaningEn: a selfie
exampleKo: 최애 오늘 셀카 올려줬어! 프사 바로 바꿔야지.
exampleEn: My bias posted a selfie today! I'm changing my profile pic right away.

meaningEn: unreleased content (photos, footage, etc.)
exampleKo: 앨범 살 때 미공개 포카 받을 수 있대!
exampleEn: They say you can get unreleased photocards when you buy the album!

meaningEn: a fandom; the official fan community of an idol group
exampleKo: 우리 팬덤 화력 미쳤다! 이번 컴백도 일위 가자!
exampleEn: Our fandom's power is insane! Let's get #1 again this comeback!

meaningEn: the official fanchant
exampleKo: 이번 신곡 공식 응원법 벌써 다 외웠다! 콘서트 준비 완료!
exampleEn: I've already memorized the official fanchant for the new song! Concert prep complete!

meaningEn: a life song; a life-changing, all-time favorite song
exampleKo: 이 노래는 내 인생곡이야. 들을 때마다 위로받아.
exampleEn: This song is my life song. I feel comforted every time I listen to it.

meaningEn: an absolute banger; a masterpiece song (playful spelling of 명곡)
exampleKo: 와, 이번 앨범 타이틀곡 진짜 띵곡이다! 무한 스트리밍 간다.
exampleEn: Wow, the title track from this album is seriously a banger! Going to stream it endlessly.

meaningEn: god-perfect; utterly flawless or impeccable
exampleKo: 최애 무대 보는데 비주얼부터 퍼포먼스까지 진짜 갓벽해.
exampleEn: Watching my bias's stage, everything from visuals to performance is truly god-perfect.

meaningEn: a heart-fluttering moment; a moment that makes your heart skip a beat
exampleKo: 최애가 갑자기 아이컨택 해줘서 심쿵했잖아!
exampleEn: My bias suddenly made eye contact with me, my heart totally skipped a beat!

meaningEn: "their form is insane"; they're absolutely killing it, performing incredibly well
exampleKo: 오늘 무대 보는데 우리 아이돌 폼 미쳤다! 역시 프로야.
exampleEn: Watching today's stage, our idol's form is insane! Professional as always.

meaningEn: legendary; the best of all time; record-breaking
exampleKo: 이번 컴백은 진짜 역대급이야! 모든 기록 다 갈아치울 듯.
exampleEn: This comeback is seriously legendary! Looks like they'll break all records.

meaningEn: a "stage genius"; an outstanding and captivating live performer
exampleKo: 우리 최애는 진짜 무대천재야. 라이브도 완벽하고 표정 연기도 최고!
exampleEn: My bias is truly a stage genius. Their live performance is perfect, and their expressions are the best!

meaningEn: an "introductory video"; the video that makes someone fall for an idol and become a fan
exampleKo: 내 입덕영상은 바로 그 직캠이었어. 아직도 보면 심장이 뛰어.
exampleEn: My introductory video was that fancam. My heart still races when I watch it.

meaningEn: an idol's agency; management label
exampleKo: 소속사가 열일해서 우리 애들 스케줄이 꽉 찼어.
exampleEn: The agency is working hard, so our faves' schedule is packed.
